title: Lekalo PHP Types Input
description: Closed independent contract for the bounded PHP type-generation input document (issue #58). The document is authored under `lekalo/types/`, names the exact compiled-IR evidence digest it consumes, and carries the closed type policy (namespace prefix, custody mode, scaffold root, class map). The compiled IR itself is never embedded: the adapter reads the core-staged evidence named by projectId from the canonical cache home and refuses any digest divergence. The document is pure data - no credentials, hosts, URLs, users, wall-clock timestamps, or provider output.

projectId.description: The project id whose compiled IR evidence is consumed; the same id the core stages at `.lekalo/cache/ir/<projectId>.json`.

irDigest.description: The exact digest of the consumed IR evidence bytes; any divergence between this digest and the staged evidence is a binding refusal, never a best-effort read.

policy.description: The closed type policy. Absent members take their documented defaults; unknown members refuse. No library codec, date library, or Composer provisioning can be declared in v0.4.0: their absence is the explicit unsupported boundary, never a silent fallback.

semanticId.description: A module-qualified lowercase Lekalo symbol id (`module.name`).

namespacePrefix.description: The generated PHP namespace prefix. The semantic module becomes one additional namespace segment, so the full FQN is `<prefix>\<Module>\<Class>`.

scaffoldRoot.description: The consumer-owned source root of scaffold-once custody. v0.4.0 closes the accepted value to the one recognized consumer convention, so the core lifecycle classifier and the adapter agree on user ownership by path convention.

custody.description: managed: regenerable bytes under the generated root with drift checks and clean authority. scaffold-once: emitted once into the declared consumer source root, then user-owned. checked: zero writes; the declared ids join read-only against observed class-shape evidence.

classMap.description: Whether a deterministic generated class map (`classmap.php`) is emitted beside the types.
